user_reported_bug: Client sent 6 observations after production deployment (photo of Excel document, answers in Google Doc): (1) Order Qty in Sales Ledger showing sum of Sale+Return instead of net (should be Sales-Returns, e.g., 100 sales - 2 returns = 98). (2) Reversal of GT & Commission not showing in DTO cases — currently zeros; should show negative reversal values, with Fixed Fee also reversed and Return Fee (Level×Zone) applied; GST removed from DTO calcs. (3) TCS & TDS being deducted — should be removed ENTIRELY from all calculations and reports (marketplace pays these, not seller). (4) Missing columns in Sales Ledger + export: Brand, Sale Type, Posting Date, Item No, Posting_Location Code, Main Ctg, Level No, Price Range Key (NSV), Price Range Key (NSV after GT). (5) Apparels — when a sub-category is not in the configured commission master, commission is picked as 0 instead of falling back to the 'ALL' catch-all commission rule for the same master_category. (6) Ability to export the Sales Ledger report to Excel with all fields.
